tools.name: get_connection_status
tools.title: Get Anchises connection status
tools.description: Use this when you need to check Anchises access, policy, and data scope. It does not query stock data.

inputSchema.description: No arguments. Call directly to inspect the current connection.

request_id.description: Server-generated request identifier for support and audit correlation.

tools.name: get_available_exchanges
tools.title: Get available exchanges
tools.description: Use this when you need valid exchange codes or the latest table and date available for each market; call it before passing exchange arguments to other tools.

inputSchema.description: No arguments. Returns every exchange in the current data scope.

request_id.description: Server-generated request identifier for support and audit correlation.

tools.name: get_latest_dates
tools.title: Get latest stock dates
tools.description: Use this when you need the latest available stock-data date for one or more known exchanges.

items.description: Uppercase exchange code returned by get_available_exchanges.

exchanges.description: One or more uppercase exchange codes from get_available_exchanges.

inputSchema.description: Provide at least one exchange code whose latest date is required.

request_id.description: Server-generated request identifier for support and audit correlation.

tools.name: get_stock_schema
tools.title: Get stock data schema
tools.description: Use this when you need exact stock field names, types, descriptions, or sample tables before screening or writing SQL.

exchange.description: Optional uppercase exchange code from get_available_exchanges. Omit or pass null to combine fields from all sampled exchanges.

inputSchema.description: Optionally narrow schema discovery to one exchange.

request_id.description: Server-generated request identifier for support and audit correlation.

tools.name: list_stock_tables
tools.title: List stock tables
tools.description: Use this when you need allowlisted historical table names for SQL or schema inspection; it does not return stock rows.

items.description: Uppercase exchange code returned by get_available_exchanges.

exchanges.description: Optional exchange filter. Omit or pass an empty array to include all available exchanges.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive lower date bound in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit or pass null for no lower bound.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive upper date bound in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit or pass null for no upper bound.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by the immediately preceding page of the same tool. Omit or pass null for the first page; never construct or edit this value.

page_size.description: Maximum rows to return on this page. Defaults to 200.

inputSchema.description: Filter allowlisted stock table names by exchange/date and paginate the result.

request_id.description: Server-generated request identifier for support and audit correlation.

next_cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by the immediately preceding page of the same tool. Omit or pass null for the first page; never construct or edit this value.

tools.name: get_table_schema
tools.title: Get table schema
tools.description: Use this when you need exact column names and types before querying allowlisted tables returned by list_stock_tables.

items.description: Exact allowlisted table name from list_stock_tables.

tables.description: One to 100 exact table names returned by list_stock_tables.

inputSchema.description: Provide exact allowlisted table names whose columns are required.

request_id.description: Server-generated request identifier for support and audit correlation.

tools.name: screen_stocks
tools.title: Screen stocks
tools.description: Use this when you need structured stock filters and sorting; prefer it over raw SQL when the requested fields and operators fit this schema.

items.description: Uppercase exchange code returned by get_available_exchanges.

exchanges.description: Optional markets to screen. Omit or pass an empty array to use every available exchange.

as_of_date.description: Optional exact market-data date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit or pass null to use each exchange's latest available table.

filters.description: Zero to 30 AND-combined filters. Field names must exactly match get_stock_schema for every selected exchange.

field.description: Exact stock column name returned by get_stock_schema, for example Price_Close or TICKER.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Use in with 1..100 values and between with exactly two ordered values.

value.description: Comparison value for this filter. Use one scalar for eq/ne/gt/gte/lt/lte; null is allowed only with eq or ne. Use an array of 1..100 scalars for in, and exactly two ordered scalars for between.

items.description: One allowlisted field comparison used in the stock screen.

sort.description: Optional ordered sort keys. Fields must match get_stock_schema for every selected exchange.

field.description: Exact stock column name returned by get_stock_schema.

direction.description: Sort direction; defaults to asc when omitted.

items.description: One sort key, evaluated in array order.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by the immediately preceding page of the same tool. Omit or pass null for the first page; never construct or edit this value.

page_size.description: Maximum rows to return on this page. Defaults to 200.

inputSchema.description: Build a safe stock screen using documented fields, structured comparisons, and pagination.

request_id.description: Server-generated request identifier for support and audit correlation.

next_cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by the immediately preceding page of the same tool. Omit or pass null for the first page; never construct or edit this value.

tools.name: validate_readonly_sql
tools.title: Validate read-only SQL
tools.description: Use this when you need to check one proposed SELECT or WITH...SELECT before execution; it never runs the statement.

sql.description: Exactly one SELECT or WITH...SELECT statement using allowlisted stock tables. DDL, DML, comments, and multiple statements are rejected.
examples: SELECT TICKER, Price_Close FROM daily_20260715_asx LIMIT 20

inputSchema.description: Validate one read-only SQL statement without executing it.

request_id.description: Server-generated request identifier for support and audit correlation.

tools.name: run_readonly_sql
tools.title: Run bounded read-only SQL
tools.description: Use this when structured screen_stocks cannot express the analysis; it executes one allowlisted read-only SELECT with bounded pagination.

sql.description: Exactly one SELECT or WITH...SELECT statement using table names from list_stock_tables and columns from get_table_schema.
examples: SELECT TICKER, Price_Close FROM daily_20260715_asx ORDER BY Price_Close DESC LIMIT 20

max_rows.description: Maximum rows the server may execute and retain. Defaults to and cannot exceed 200,000.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by the immediately preceding page of the same tool. Omit or pass null for the first page; never construct or edit this value.

page_size.description: Maximum rows to return on this page. Defaults to 200.

inputSchema.description: Execute one allowlisted read-only SQL query and return a query_id plus a bounded page.

request_id.description: Server-generated request identifier for support and audit correlation.

next_cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by the immediately preceding page of the same tool. Omit or pass null for the first page; never construct or edit this value.

tools.name: get_latest_company_report
tools.title: Get latest English company report
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for the latest available English Anchises AI-generated company report and optional PDF for a known exchange and ticker. Do not use it for official annual reports, regulatory filings, live news, web search, or generating a new report.

exchange.description: Uppercase listing exchange for the company. Must be one of ASX, CSE, NASDAQ, NYSE, TSX, or TSXV.

ticker.description: Exchange-listed ticker symbol, using letters, numbers, dots, or hyphens; for example BGL or BRK.B.

source.description: Report cache to read. auto compares ondemand and macmini and returns the newest; an explicit source restricts lookup to that source. Defaults to auto.

pdf_range.description: Market-history window rendered in the PDF chart. Defaults to MAX; this does not change the report text.

inputSchema.description: Read one latest cached English Anchises AI company report. This tool never starts report generation.

request_id.description: Server-generated request identifier for support and audit correlation.

tools.name: create_csv_export
tools.title: Create temporary CSV export
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly asks to download a prior screen_stocks or run_readonly_sql result as CSV.

query_id.description: Exact query_id returned by the preceding screen_stocks or run_readonly_sql call in the current access mode.

expires_in_seconds.description: Signed download lifetime in seconds. Defaults to 3600 (60 minutes).

inputSchema.description: Create a temporary bearer download from an existing query_id; never invent a query_id.

request_id.description: Server-generated request identifier for support and audit correlation.
